one_month_reasoning: The window contains Q3 2026 results on Oct 27 (source 2). Guidance is revenue $210-216M, product $110-116M, non-GAAP EPS $0.75-0.82 (source 1). Supply-chain read-throughs are mixed. Montage's Q2 interconnect revenue rose about 20% QoQ, and Micron says demand exceeds supply, both supportive of a beat on product revenue. But TrendForce sees 2027 RDIMM bit supply growing only 15-20%, so the Q4 and 2027 commentary, especially on RDIMM unit growth, is the swing factor. Three of the last three prints moved the stock 9-23% (Feb and Apr down, Jul down), so the reaction distribution is wide. The stock is also up about 29% from $86.89 on Sep 8 (source 14), which leaves some reversal risk. Net: a centred distribution (median about $111.5) with a monthly sigma of about 17%. That is a bit below 80%/3.5 because the 80% realized figure is inflated by three earnings gaps, but it is widened for the in-window print.

fair_value.method: Blend for Oct-2027: 28x 2028E non-GAAP EPS of $3.90 = $109 (50%); FCF yield of 3.2% on 2028E FCF/share of $3.40 = $106 (30%); 11x EV/2027E sales of $930M plus $0.85B cash over 110M shares = $101 (20%).

inputs_detail.derivation: Q1 about $0.64 (implied by Q2 $0.77 being +21% QoQ) + Q2 $0.77 + Q3 guide midpoint $0.785 + Q4 about $0.85 on continued product growth

Product revenue about +22% (RDIMM units +12-18% per Baird/TrendForce supply limits, plus PMIC/companion share gains and an MRDIMM start in 2027). Royalties roughly flat at about $300M; contract revenue about $110M. Revenue about $930M with about 40% non-GAAP net margin and 110M shares.
About 13% growth as the MRDIMM ramp (4x content, about $600M TAM) broadens on Venice/Diamond Rapids and the DRAM supply squeeze moderates

The stock trades about 34x NTM EPS of about $3.30 today, and at about 28x at the Sep 8 low of $86.89. At the horizon I assume some compression toward the high-20s given volume-only exposure to the DRAM supply squeeze and the DOJ overhang.
FCF runs about 85-90% of non-GAAP net income (Q2 OCF $61.2M vs non-GAAP NI $84.4M, with lumpy royalty cash timing). Applied to 2028E EPS of $3.90.
Consistent with a high-20s P/E on cash earnings for a fabless, net-cash semi IP/chip name

bear.story: The DRAM squeeze diverts capacity to HBM/SOCAMM2, so 2027 RDIMM units grow only about 10%. Montage's 5th/6th-gen RCDs take share, MRDIMM slips with Diamond Rapids, and the DOJ probe escalates. 2027 EPS of about $3.0-3.2 at about 20x.

base.story: RDIMM units +12-18%, PMIC/companion chips and the early MRDIMM ramp lift product revenue about 20%, and royalties hold. 2028E EPS of about $3.90 at 28-29x.

bull.story: Server shipments grow faster than in 2026 (TrendForce) and DRAM supply loosens in 2H27. MRDIMM ramps on Venice, RCD share moves past 45%, and companion chips scale. 2028E EPS of about $4.80 at 35x, back toward the 52-week high.

thesis_break_reason: Below about $70 (about 22x my 2026E EPS and well under the Sep low of $87), the market would be pricing falling 2027 earnings rather than slower growth. That would most likely mean RCD share loss to Montage/Renesas, an outright RDIMM unit decline from DRAM supply diversion, or a material adverse DOJ outcome, not ordinary volatility.

Timing of the MRDIMM ramp given the Diamond Rapids slip to 2027

reasoning: Industry evidence is mixed. On the positive side, demand is strong: Micron says demand will exceed supply beyond CY2027, TrendForce expects server shipments to grow faster in 2027 than 2026's 17%, Montage's interconnect revenue grew 26% in H1 with Q2 up about 20% QoQ, and the MRDIMM/companion-chip content story is intact. On the negative side, Rambus is a per-unit supplier, and TrendForce sees 2027 RDIMM bit supply growing only 15-20% while customers shift to smaller 32/64GB modules. That mix supports unit growth but not explosive growth, matching Baird's 12-15% 2027 RDIMM unit call. Montage is also advancing quickly on RCD generations, and Diamond Rapids slipping to 2027 pushes the MRDIMM content step-up out. My EPS path is $3.05 (2026E), $3.45 (2027E) and $3.90 (2028E). The blended fair value is $106, close to the $111.97 spot, so I centre the 12-month distribution near $110. I use a lognormal sigma of 0.55: below the 80% realized figure, which is inflated by three large earnings gaps and a 30% September rally, but well above large-cap norms. The scenarios have a probability-weighted mean of about $115 with fat tails (bear $65, bull $170). For the 1-month ladder the Oct 27 print is the only scheduled event, so I keep it symmetric around spot with a sigma of 17%.
